items.title: Israel strikes Tyre after ordering evacuation of south Lebanon city
items.description: Israel's military says it struck Hezbollah targets after telling residents it would "act forcefully" against the group.

items.title: Ebola-hit DR Congo faces 'catastrophic collision' of disease and conflict, WHO warns
items.description: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said fighting in DR Congo was hampering efforts to stop spread

items.title: Trump says US 'not satisfied' with Iran deal yet
items.description: The US president says he believes Iran wants to reach a deal but there is still no agreement on its terms.

items.title: Five people found alive after week trapped in flooded Laos cave
items.description: The search is continuing for a further two villagers who are still missing, rescuers say.

items.title: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills new head of Hamas's military wing
items.description: Hamas says Mohammed Odeh was killed alongside his wife and two children in a strike on a residential building.

items.title: Woman caught after 30 years on the run is jailed for armed robberies
items.description: Klette was finally caught in a flat in Berlin in 2024 and put on trial last year.

items.title: One killed and nine missing after chemical explosion at US paper mill
items.description: Nine others were injured and another nine are missing after a tank ruptured at a paper mill in Longview, Washington.

items.title: Hotel that refused to give tourist tap water acted lawfully, Italian court rules
items.description: The Italian Supreme Court rejected a tourist's claim that her consumer rights were breached when she was only offered €7 bottled mineral water.

items.title: Ghana welcomes Pope's apology over Catholic Church's role in slavery
items.description: The West African nation was one of the main gateways for the transatlantic slave trade.

items.title: Trump-backed challenger beats veteran US senator in Texas primary
items.description: Ken Paxton's victory sets up what will be a closely watched contest in November's midterm elections.

items.title: South Korea detains dissident who fled China in rubber boat
items.description: Dong Guangping, an activist and former police officer, spent hours at sea before reaching Korean waters.

items.title: YouTuber arrested for allegedly using AI to defame Korean actor
items.description: The YouTuber allegedly made false claims that fuelled a career-ending scandal for Kim Soo-hyun.
